messages.content: The hotel check changed. The Omni now has the conference rate only Wednesday and Thursday, not Friday. Please compare the actual three-night totals before we send anything to the office.

I have three workable choices for October 15-18. The Omni for two nights plus a Friday move totals $851 including quoted taxes. The nearby business hotel is $792 for all three nights. The Midtown property near Friday's hosted dinner is $861 for all three nights. None of those figures includes parking, which you should not need.
Which hotels are the second and third options, and how far are they from the daytime sessions?

The all-three-night business option is the Hilton Garden Inn Atlanta Downtown. It is about a 12- to 15-minute walk to the GWCC campus, subject to the conference building. The dinner-area option is the Georgian Terrace. From there, allow roughly 25 to 30 minutes by MARTA and walking to the GWCC, or longer on foot.
And the Friday dinner is still at South City Kitchen Midtown?

Yes. That venue is separate from the conference hotel. The Georgian Terrace is about an 8- to 10-minute walk from the restaurant. From the Hilton Garden Inn, plan on roughly 20 to 25 minutes by MARTA plus walking, or about 10 to 20 minutes by car depending on traffic.
Spell out the split stay. I do not want the lower-looking number to hide another room night or a transfer cost.

The split would be Omni Wednesday and Thursday for $564 all-in, then Georgian Terrace Friday for $287 all-in, totaling $851 for all three nights. You would check out Friday morning, store or move the bag, attend the conference, and check in again before or after dinner. A rideshare or other transfer would be additional.
So it saves only $10 against staying at the Georgian Terrace all three nights, and costs $59 more than the Hilton Garden Inn?

Correct. It also creates a Friday hotel change during a full conference day. Its only clear benefit is keeping you in the conference hotel for the first two nights while placing you near dinner on Friday.
What are the cancellation terms on the three arrangements?

The quoted Hilton Garden Inn rate can be canceled without charge until 11:59 p.m. local time on October 13. The Omni conference-rate nights require cancellation by October 8. The Georgian Terrace quote is refundable until 6:00 p.m. local time on October 14. Those deadlines and the tax-inclusive totals still need confirmation on the live booking pages.
The split does not earn its trouble. Use the Hilton Garden Inn for all three nights. Prepare one reservation for the office, but do not claim it is booked.

Reservation request prepared: Hilton Garden Inn Atlanta Downtown, check-in Wednesday, October 15; check-out Saturday, October 18; one adult, one room, three nights. Working total: $792 including quoted taxes, with no mandatory destination fee shown. Request the refundable rate with cancellation through October 13. The hotel is approximately a 12- to 15-minute walk from the GWCC campus and requires a separate trip to South City Kitchen Midtown Friday evening. Before purchase, the office should verify the exact room type, final taxes and fees, cancellation cutoff and time zone, and the route to the conference's assigned GWCC building. The selected Denver-Atlanta flights remain unchanged, and nothing has been booked.
